# Digital-Mailroom: appendix {.page-title}

[Public corpus · partner boundary]{.kicker}

Supporting notes for the [Digital-Mailroom case study](../digital-mailroom.qmd). The capstone publishes no measured results here; these tables describe the data boundary and where the public corpus comes from.

## Public and non-public

| Public on this site | Not published |
| --- | --- |
| The capstone problem framing and pipeline description | The partner's documents |
| The public-source corpus and its provenance | Internal partner metrics |
| The classifier work that feeds the pipeline | Non-public evaluation results |
| Reproduction notes for the public pieces | Anything under a partner confidentiality agreement |

The industry partner scoped the problem and met with me through the capstone. Their data was never used to build the corpus.

## Corpus sources

The public corpus has 3,302 documents. No partner documents are included.

| Class | Rows | Source | Terms |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Insurance claim | 1,100 | CMS DE-SynPUF, GNOTHEIA, BDR, INSURBIAS | Apache-2.0, MIT, CC BY 4.0 |
| Correspondence | 1,000 | Deduplicated Enron email | Research use; real named-person PII |
| Contract | 600 | CUAD v1 (509) and SEC EDGAR EX-10 (91) | CC BY 4.0; public domain |
| Corporate record | 450 | SEC EDGAR S-1 and 8-K exhibits | Public domain |
| Merger agreement | 152 | MAUD v1 | CC BY 4.0 |

The [Corpus EDA appendix](../mailroom-corpus-eda/appendix.qmd) records label provenance, configuration counts and context bands. The [dataset card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lucius-Morningstar/mailroom-dataset/tree/v9.2) carries the versioned citation.

## Where the code lives

The linked repository is the integration workspace: one lockfile and one virtual environment wiring the standalone packages together. Package code is authored and released from its own repository, then imported, so a fix belongs upstream rather than in the workspace copy.

## Status

Measured capstone results remain unpublished while the project is running, with expected completion in December 2026. This appendix will not carry numbers before the partner-facing report exists.

:::
